name: Half-Dragon
summary: A humanoid of draconic heritage that claws and breathes energy of its origin.

resistances: Damage type chosen for the Draconic Origin trait below

traits.name: Draconic Origin
traits.text: The half-dragon is related to a type of dragon associated with one of the following damage types (GM's choice): Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. This choice affects other aspects of the stat block.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The half-dragon makes two Claw attacks.

damage.note: of the type chosen for the Draconic Origin trait

actions.name: Dragon's Breath
actions.onFailure: {dmg:8d6} damage of the type chosen for the Draconic Origin trait.

bonusActions.name: Leap
bonusActions.text: The half-dragon jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
